problem: Private action pending consent was created before topic acceptance disclosed its prompt; users could lose the action acceptance window while agreeing on the topic.
change: Create a fresh private action offer only after bilateral topic acceptance has made its exact prompt active. Public action timing is unchanged.
compatibility: No wire/schema/snapshot change. Previously stored action offers retain their deadlines; startup still revokes private scopes. Both versions use ROOM-TOPIC-2.
rollback: The previous image is compatible with unchanged schema/policy, but retains the known early-action-timer usability defect. Quiesce private scopes before operational fallback, preserve history/exclusions/receipts and keep new private starts disabled until a corrected version is active.
evidence_scope: Focused host timing regression is not PostgreSQL/browser proof and does not establish the sole cause of METHOD18 pause/stop.
actual_regression: P05-TG-06 adds 29 seconds of pending topic acceptance, a fresh 30 second action window, separate bilateral action accepts after the old deadline, and an unchanged invitation parent.
